summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong listing rules, detailing ongoing share repurchases for cancellation. Filed on June 29, 2026, the return covers multiple buyback transactions from April through June 2026 at per-share prices ranging from approximately USD 0.9366 to USD 1.2768, corresponding to the issuer's share buyback program. The repurchases represent small percentages (0.034% to 0.157%) of existing issued shares. The shares are canceled upon settlement. This capital-return activity returns cash to shareholders and reduces share count. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K serves as a current report equivalent to a domestic 8-K. Watch for further buyback activity or completion of the program.
